about: S3.8 governance checks (DOC-07) — the HELD-OUT set: fictional companies written in other styles (US stock, other phrasings) before diligence-s3.8 was run on them, never used to change it, run once per version.

documents.name: Bylaws - Ardent Robotics.txt
documents.text:
BYLAWS of Ardent Robotics, Inc. (fictional)

1. Stock
1.1 The authorized capital stock of the corporation consists of common stock and Series A preferred stock.

2. Board
2.1 The number of directors shall not be less than three.

documents.name: Cap table - Ardent Robotics.txt
documents.text:
CAP TABLE of Ardent Robotics, Inc. (fictional)

1. Maya Chen: 4,000,000 shares of common stock.
2. Luis Ortega: 1,000,000 shares of common stock.

documents.name: Board consent January 2026.txt
documents.text:
WRITTEN CONSENT OF THE BOARD of Ardent Robotics, Inc. (fictional)

1. Issuance
1.1 The Board approved the issuance of 4,500,000 shares of common stock to the founders.

2. Founders
2.1 The founders are Maya Chen and Luis Ortega.

documents.name: Delegation of authority - Ardent.txt
documents.text:
DELEGATION OF AUTHORITY of Ardent Robotics, Inc. (fictional)

1. Contracts
1.1 The Chief Executive Officer may sign contracts with a value of up to USD 500,000.

documents.name: Master Supply Agreement - Kestrel.txt
documents.text:
MASTER SUPPLY AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is between Kestrel Parts Co. and Ardent Robotics, Inc.

1. Value
1.1 The total contract value is USD 750,000.

2. Execution
2.1 Signed on behalf of Ardent Robotics, Inc. by Maya Chen, Chief Executive Officer.

documents.name: Board governance policy - Ardent.txt
documents.text:
BOARD GOVERNANCE POLICY of Ardent Robotics, Inc. (fictional)

1. Composition
1.1 The Board shall have at least two directors.

documents.name: Invention Assignment - Maya Chen.txt
documents.text:
INVENTION ASSIGNMENT AGREEMENT (fictional)

1.1 Maya Chen assigns to Ardent Robotics, Inc. all inventions made for the corporation.

expect: No IP assignment from Luis Ortega

documents.name: Articles of Association - Brenner Medical UK.txt
documents.text:
ARTICLES OF ASSOCIATION of Brenner Medical UK Ltd (fictional)

1. Shares
1.1 The company's shares are divided into ordinary shares of GBP 1 each.

2. Board meetings
2.1 Board meetings require not less than five (5) days' notice.

documents.text:
REGISTER OF MEMBERS of Brenner Medical UK Ltd (fictional)

1. Brenner Medical GmbH — 10,000 ordinary shares.

documents.name: Board minutes April 2026.txt
documents.text:
MINUTES OF A BOARD MEETING of Brenner Medical UK Ltd (fictional)

1. Allotment
1.1 It was resolved that 10,000 ordinary shares be allotted to Brenner Medical GmbH.

documents.name: Delegation of authority - Brenner Medical UK.txt
documents.text:
DELEGATION OF AUTHORITY of Brenner Medical UK Ltd (fictional)

1. Contracts
1.1 The Operations Manager may sign contracts with a value of up to GBP 25,000.
1.2 Contracts above GBP 25,000 require the approval of two directors.

documents.name: Services Agreement - CleanCo.txt
documents.text:
SERVICES AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is between CleanCo Facilities Ltd and Brenner Medical UK Ltd.

1. Fees
1.1 The total fees payable under this Agreement are GBP 40,000.

2. Signature
2.1 Signed for Brenner Medical UK Ltd by S. Patel, Operations Manager.

documents.name: Board procedures - Brenner Medical UK.txt
documents.text:
BOARD PROCEDURES of Brenner Medical UK Ltd (fictional)

1. Meetings
1.1 Directors may convene a board meeting on 24 hours' notice.
